payload.build_scope: Copy-scope PREVIEW only: a standalone, mobile-first rendering of 30-page-copy.json revision 2 in launch state, for the QA gate's automated checks and screenshots. Not the deliverable; nothing written under site/. Live raw HTML unavailable (weddedwonderland.com blocked), so the live template was not reproduced.
schema_notes: One @graph: TouristDestination (containedInPlace Continent Europe, description = approved meta description), ItemList of the 5 regions (names only, no prices, no URLs: the Lisbon and Algarve child pages are planned 404s, F006), Service (Wedded Concierge, provider Organization, areaServed Country Portugal, url /wonderland-concierge, description = confirmed F088 sentence), BreadcrumbList Home > Destinations > Europe > Portugal, FAQPage (10 Q&A, fallback versions, word for word with the visible text; the FAQ 1 link is plain text), Organization.
No Article, Person, Offer, AggregateRating or ImageObject (images not final). No unconfirmed sign-off fact in schema: FAQ answers carry only the fallback lines, the same text as the page.
schema.jsonld is the bare JSON-LD object (no <script> wrapper) for the CMS handoff; it is byte-identical in content to the block in preview.html (verified by parse and compare).
payload.automated_checks: python3 studio/tools/check_page.py studio/runs/portugal-20261028-1500/preview.html --facts studio/runs/portugal-20261028-1500/facts.json --brief studio/runs/portugal-20261028-1500/20-content-brief.json --out studio/runs/portugal-20261028-1500/60-automated-qa.json: 29/30 passed; blockers=1 (noindex_while_unconfirmed, accepted by design under D2), majors=0, minors=0. Word count 3632 (visible text including captions, form labels and header; brief 2400-3200, checker tolerance 1920-4800), internal links 19, external links 11 (10 official sources plus Parques de Sintra, all target _blank rel noopener).
payload.screenshot_notes: Playwright chromium, deviceScaleFactor 1, file:// URL. mobile-full.png (390x844 viewport, page height about 32,000 px) and desktop-full.png (1440x900, about 17,500 px); mobile-01 to mobile-38 and desktop-01 to desktop-20 are viewport-height slices taken by scrolling, so the mobile sticky bar shows at the bottom of each mobile slice (as a user sees it) and hides while the form is in view. In the full-page mobile capture the fixed sticky bar appears once, over the hero area. No horizontal scroll at 390 px (scrollWidth 390).

lighthouse.reason: No public URL: the preview is a local file in the run folder (file://) and the live site is blocked from this environment, so DataForSEO on_page_lighthouse cannot reach it. Run Lighthouse on staging after the CMS changes are applied.

payload.robots: index, follow (D2: live, indexed page; sign-off-dependent copy is held behind fallbacks instead of adding noindex)
rendering_rules_applied: Every [APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF] / [FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] pair renders only the fallback, with data-signoff on its element: F019 (B8 strip), F076 (B16 Algarve card heading, body and caption), F066 (s3 Beaches card heading and body), F024 (legal tab bullet, FAQ 9), F043 (US block, FAQ 2), F069 (Costs tab, FAQ 4), F077 (s7 Douro line). The applied lines and the cost table are HTML comments only. Scripted scan of visible text: no Blue Flag, Ponta da Piedade, Lagos, river trips, EUR or USD amounts, 120,000+/17+ or Rita Plácido text.

s8 real weddings not rendered; an HTML comment marks the slot. CMS notes, tab labels, anchors and placement notes are HTML comments. add-beach-line appears once, inside the Algarve card, as its placement note says; the palace strip sits under the Lisbon card.
s5 tabs render as a chip nav of anchor links plus stacked panels (#getting-there, #entry-rules, #marrying-legally, #costs, #your-weekend). FAQ renders as visible H3 question plus answer pairs.

33 image slots as
with neutral backgrounds; file names kebab-case and descriptive; alt text 125 characters or fewer, from the copy captions and research-doc section 6 shot briefs; captions shown as figcaption. Hero slot marked data-fetchpriority=high, the rest data-loading=lazy (no elements yet, so width/height/srcset apply at image delivery). Slots that would depict unsigned facts use generic names and alt (algarve-coast-clifftops-atlantic.jpg, no Ponta da Piedade; Douro without boats).

Enquiry form posts to /api/concierge/enquiry with hidden route_to=wedded-concierge, destination=Portugal, page_slug=/destinations/europe/portugal, offer, entry_point and utm_source/medium/campaign/term/content; all visible fields labelled; error messages as data attributes; success state in a <template>. B9 bar is a separate group (not a form) that prefills Season, Guests and Celebration, sets entry_point=b9 and scrolls to #enquire; region buttons set offer and Region; every #enquire button sets its entry_point. Inline script only, no external scripts or fonts.

issues.detail: noindex_while_unconfirmed fails by design (D2). 31 facts are unconfirmed or in conflict; none of the sign-off-pair facts are shown.

Two links have no confirmed URL and render as placeholder anchors marked data-url-status=to-confirm: 'Start for free' (Wonderland Studio, s7) and 'Privacy Policy' (form consent line). Dev to supply before publish.

Breadcrumb 'Destinations' hub URL is not confirmed in this run. Visible breadcrumb shows it as plain text; schema uses https://weddedwonderland.com/destinations. Confirm the hub exists, or point the item at the real hub URL.
No og:image yet (needs a final, rights-cleared 1200x630 hero). ImageObject schema and responsive srcset wait for final images.

Captions repeat their card body almost word for word in places (B16 Queluz, Pena and Douro; s9 cards), which reads as duplication on screen. Copy or design call: drop captions on cards, or vary them. The preview shows captions because they are approved copy.

B16 Queluz card line reads awkwardly: 'whose upper gardens and Throne Room Parques de Sintra offers for celebrations'. FAQ 3 opens 'A Catholic ceremony is: Catholic marriage is...', also awkward. Not changed (copy is approved).
Sticky bar button 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' wraps to two lines at 390 px and the label wraps beside it (known label question, copy_limits sticky_bar 12 characters).
Rendered visible word count is 3,632 including captions, form and chrome; the copy's own count is 3,113 against the 2400-3200 brief. Within checker tolerance; no failure.
